display_name: Ensure Periodic Ledger Event-Embedding Drain Schedule
description:
Idempotently install (or normalize) a single cron schedule that fires `service_interface::session_ledger_service::drain_event_embeddings` every `cadence_minutes` minutes. Mirrors `ensure_periodic_summarize_schedule` for the LED-01 event-content embedding path: clears any existing schedules tagged `ledger:periodic_embed`, then creates one fresh schedule with the requested cadence.

Boot-only — wired via the profile's `starting_actions` so a fresh solet starts embedding her own event content the moment her services come up, and the historical backlog drains in the background. The `is_discoverable=False` flag keeps the verb out of the model's `process_search` results; operator-initiated re-runs go through the operator bridge directly.

Fails fast if scheduling_service is not bound at session_ledger_service construction. Returns `{outcome, schedule_id, tag, cadence_minutes, cleared_count}` where `outcome` is `created` (fresh) or `normalized` (stale/duplicate schedules cleared first).
embedding_description: Boot-wired schedule that makes the searchable event-content index fill and stay current on its own: it registers the recurring job that periodically drains not-yet-embedded USER/ASSISTANT ledger messages through the local embedder, so a fresh solet backfills her historical event backlog and keeps it current with no operator loop. Idempotent, tagged ledger:periodic_embed.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Periodic event-embedding-drain schedule status — outcome created or normalized after duplicate cleanup, plus the active schedule_id.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: The ledger now drains not-yet-embedded event content every configured interval. If you are diagnosing whether event embeddings are landing, run a search_event_content query (or watch the drain's completion log line) after the next firing rather than re-running this verb.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Ensuring a single periodic event-embedding-drain cron schedule for the LLM session ledger
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: RuntimeError: scheduling_service not bound (profile omits scheduling). ValueError: cadence_minutes out of the 1..59 range. SchedulerError: scheduling backend rejected the cron expression or refused to clear/create the schedule.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: If scheduling is unavailable, the operator can invoke drain_event_embeddings directly from the operator bridge as a one-shot. If cadence validation failed, retry with a value in [1, 59].
